name: cmaps
description: GeoAtlas is a modern, serverless web application built with vanilla JavaScript and Leaflet.js. It provides a sleek interface for exploring the world with OpenStreetMap.

scripts.build:mobile: vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('mobile/www', {recursive: true}); fs.cpSync('dist', 'mobile/www', {recursive: true})" && cd mobile && npx @capacitor/cli sync
